## 1. MANDATORY FIRST ACTION — RECOVER INTERRUPTED DEVELOPMENT
The previous Claude session stopped mid-implementation due to usage limits. Recover its actual state before new programming. Inspect local workspace, current branch, git status, staged/unstaged/untracked files, recent commits and remote refs. Investigate pending schema v3, Item importer, Pokédex availability work, Notes/Item UI, popout text controls and foundations for My Pokémon, Showcase, Guide/Map. Preserve every recoverable file. Fetch latest origin/develop, reconcile safely with any local changes (no destructive reset, forced checkout/clean/force-push), then continue from the real last completed step. If workspace inaccessible, inspect repository history/session artifacts and report lost work instead of claiming recovery. This is a substantial programming assignment, not a request for planning-only docs.

Do not overwrite existing user databases, ROMs, themes, item dumps or unrelated projects. Do not install unrelated system packages. Commit meaningful milestones to develop after tests and verify push.

## 3. NEW OWNER DECISIONS — DO NOT OMIT
- REMOVE the Damage Calculator user-facing feature for now, including navigation, Quick Access, dashboard actions, popout registration, settings and stale/dead links. Handle saved references gracefully. Do not remove shared code used elsewhere.
- KEEP researched/implemented/tested tools as normal tools WITHOUT noisy Experimental or Verified badges. Experimental only for truly incomplete/unresearched features; identify uncertain individual records contextually.
- The owner will NOT manually test every calculation. Use comparison-based research and AUTOMATED regression tests. Owner videos remain for visual, native-window and usability review.
- Breeding uses FIXED baseline price estimates; optional custom price overrides may remain if already implemented. NO live GTL pricing requirement.
- NO PokeMMO Hub API integration, prices, price charts, provider abstraction, watchlists, external dataset mirroring or Hub icons. Hub may appear as a normal user bookmark and may serve as a research comparison source. Attribution by itself does not grant rights to copy protected materials.
- Prioritize useful functioning tools over many decorative mockups and placeholders.
- Keep v0.1.0 on develop; main untouched; no release.

## 4. POKÉDEX — SYNERGY-STYLE CATALOG, NOT 644
Follow docs/design/19-SYNERGY-POKEDEX-REFERENCE.md and https://synergymmo.com/pokedex/. Owner wants a species + alternate-form browse catalog matching Synergy coverage where independently verifiable; public reference showed about 731 entries as of 2026-11-22, NOT 731 distinct species or catchable/in-game Dex entries.

Build lawful original browse data for Gen I–V base 649 and verified forms (Deoxys, Rotom, Castform, Burmy/Wormadam, Shellos/Gastrodon, Deerling/Sawsbuck, Basculin, Darmanitan, genies Incarnate/Therian, Kyurem, Keldeo, Meloetta, Genesect and other supported forms). Proper species IDs + stable form keys; form-specific types/stats/abilities/moves where verified. Group by generation. Dense sprite-led responsive scrolling, filters, search, detailed views and complete catalog in all Compact/Standard/Expanded popouts with no 60/200 entry caps. Track reference manifest parity by normalized (species_id, form_key), not merely matching a total.

Separate browse catalog, in-game Dex membership, permanent wild acquisition, raid, roaming, event, temporary storyline, personal Seen/Owned/OT/Alpha/Shiny/Costume; NEVER infer one from another. Do not hardcode 604/644/649 as obtainable totals. Do not copy Synergy code/assets/proprietary datasets.

Correct #640 Virizion: permanent raid acquisition, not unavailable; research Cobalion, Terrakion, Heatran, Cresselia, Meloetta, roaming birds/beasts, Keldeo, Genies and other special legends. Record source dates, game patch applicability and uncertainty. Add regression tests and preserve existing personal registry.

## 7. NEW: WEBSITES & FAVORITE LINKS PAGE
Read the full spec docs/design/20-WEBSITES-LINKS-AND-KEYBOARD-SHORTCUTS.md. Implement Tools > Websites / Links as a genuine user-managed bookmarks page; optional Quick Access pin. No sixth primary navigation destination.

Seed editable/removable defaults: PokeMMO Forums https://forums.pokemmo.com/, official site https://pokemmo.com/, support https://support.pokemmo.com/, Synergy https://synergymmo.com/, PokeMMO Hub https://pokemmohub.com/. These are external browser bookmarks ONLY; no API, scraping, embedded client or asset redistribution. Custom add/edit/delete/reorder, title, URL, description, categories, favourite/pin, search/filter and persistence. Never reinsert user-deleted defaults on migration. Open validated HTTPS URLs in the DEFAULT EXTERNAL BROWSER via Qt native URL integration. Reject javascript:, file:, data: and shell/custom command schemes. Handle browser launch failures and escaped text safely. No tracking.

Provide testable end-to-end functionality with stable bookmark IDs, local storage/backups, URL validation, no duplicate default seeding and no dead buttons.

## 8. NEW: CONFIGURABLE KEYBINDS / SHORTCUTS
Read full design-20 spec. Add Settings > Keyboard Shortcuts with registered action names, current binding, record-new-key flow, edit, clear, reset, conflict/reserved-shortcut handling, focus/scope display, persistence and accessibility. Stable action IDs; actions scoped to active focused tool unless explicitly allowed otherwise. Global shortcuts OFF by default; optional global support only when reliable, opt-in, platform-tested and nonintrusive. KDE Wayland may limit global registration. NEVER send keystrokes to PokeMMO or steal focus from gameplay without user action.

Implement functioning Storyline Guide controls:
- Toggle currently selected objective complete/incomplete.
- Move to next objective.
- Move to previous objective.
- Optional show/hide Guide popout if safe.
- Respect active named character run, region, guide and stable step ID. Sync main Guides and popout via existing manual local progress store; never complete another step/run accidentally. Boundaries should navigate safely without implicit completion.
- Suggested remappable focused-only combos, if no conflicts: Ctrl+Shift+Right / Ctrl+Shift+Left / Ctrl+Shift+Enter; else leave unassigned with easy binding UI. Nothing global by default.
- Do not fire while text inputs or dialogs have focus; prevent unintended double-toggles from auto-repeat or multiple windows. Other tools may register meaningful actions (popout focus, Notes new note, Pokédex search) only if actually implemented. No inert bind options.

Tests: recording/remapping, persistence, conflict detection, focused-only operation, text editing suppression, next/previous boundaries, one toggle per keypress, per-character isolation, Windows/KDE limitations reported honestly.

## 9. BREEDING PLANNER — GAME-ACCURATE, FIXED PRICES
Keep Parent A | Offspring | Parent B and existing plans. PokeMMO breeding CONSUMES both parents. Support genuinely verified compatibility, egg groups, species/gender inheritance, IV braces, nature/Everstone, move inheritance, Alpha/Shiny/Hidden Ability exceptions with unknowns where necessary. Standard 2/3/4/5-IV from-scratch tree and nature tree. Reference counts/prices: 2x31 -> 2 starters/¥20,000; 3x31 -> 4/¥65,000; 4x31 -> 8/¥155,000; 5x31 -> 16/¥340,000, all reference estimates only. Standard 5x31 + nature = 32 starting parents, 31 operations as researched; ensure actual tree generation and totals are internally consistent, avoid confusing parents vs operations. Reference 3's, PokeMMO Hub, MMOBreeder, PikaMMO, Unovamata and PokePal for public mechanics; do not copy unlicensed implementation.

Calculate braces, Everstones, gender selection and owned materials with FIXED editable baseline price constants, no GTL data. Test inheritance, counts, costs, parent consumption, persistent plans. Existing overrides can remain.

## 10. CATCH CALCULATOR — UPDATED POKÉMMO FOUNDATION
Use researched PokeMMO-specific Gen III/IV-like capture probability as a foundation; compare public implementations including PokeMMO Hub, ShakeChecker, C4vv, PokeMMO Help, MMOBreeder and Synergy where accessible. Input species/form, valid base catch rate, current/max HP, status, ball, contextual conditions, Alpha rates if verified. Implement reliable conditional Quick/Timer/Net/Nest/Dusk/Repeat/Dream behavior, with PokeMMO-specific modifiers rather than assuming maxima at all times. Separate formulas from updateable species data. Lickitung base catch rate was 45 -> 75 on official 2026-10-30 patch: add regression test. Confirm location-specific Dusk Ball changes. Validate near-100% rounding, don't label rounded estimates guaranteed. Avoid executing external JSON formula strings. User need not manually check each input.

## 11. STAT CALCULATOR — MATCHED CORE FORMULAS
Use identical Gen III+ stat formulas confirmed in separate PokeMMO Showdown and PokéStats implementations. Inputs species/form, level, nature, IV, EV; output HP/Atk/Def/SpA/SpD/Spe including level 50 and 100 scenarios. Nature multipliers 1.1/0.9/1.0 with correct integer floors; IV range 0-31, EV max 252 per stat/510 total, Shedinja HP 1; form-specific current PokeMMO base stats. Test neutral/boosted/reduced natures, zero/max values, level extremes, forms. Do not reintroduce Damage Calculator.

## 12. EV / HORDE PLANNER
Improve horde/EV search by region, location, method, horde size 3/5, time/season where confirmed, target/current EVs. Arithmetic for per-mon yield, full/mixed hordes, verified Macho Brace/Training Link effects, caps and remaining horde count. Do not import mainline Power-item EV multipliers or Pokérus without PokeMMO-specific evidence. Official July 2026 encounter overhaul makes older lists stale; 3's Tool is missing Basculin and differs from newer Route 119 sources. Compare PikaMMO, 3's, Synergy, MMOBreeder and current in-game data. Do not invent encounter rates. Source/date and narrow warning for uncertain records instead of marking entire researched tool Experimental. Test numeric EV arithmetic and missing data.

Settings should organize per-tool config, opacity, scale, appearance, popout control, notification options, quiet hours, privacy, backups, named runs, links and keyboard shortcuts. English primary; ES/Chinese beta translation foundations with fallback, no false claims translations complete.

## 16. SHARED DATA, LEGALITY AND PRIVACY
Centralize species/form IDs, item local IDs, source version, stats/types/moves/EV/catch rates, breeding and encounter/availability provenance to avoid divergent tools. Current official PokeMMO notes and dated game evidence outrank old community datasets. No game memory reading/injection, game inputs, botting, macros, packet interception, unsupported dumps, copying unlicensed third-party code/data/icons or redistributing client assets. PokeMMO Hub remains a BOOKMARK and research comparison source ONLY, not a data/API dependency. No GTL API, price watcher, charts or speculative provider abstraction.

## 17. DATA SAFETY
Versioned SQLite migrations, backup before risky changes, idempotent upgrades, preservation of existing runs/progress, Pokédex registration, item references, notes, favourites, popout geometry, keybind configs, user bookmarks, personal collection and settings. Do not infer the user's existing app is closed. Fail safely. Never modify original ROM, PokeMMO Flatpak, themes or user-private dumps. Test upgrade from existing schemas, not only blank installs.
